title: Systems and Digital Solutions Intern
description: Title: Systems and Digital Solutions Intern Type of contract: Paid internship Contract duration: 6 months Work time: Full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time Reporting to: Systems and Digital Solutions Coordinator Technical guidance: BI and Systems Officer Location: Remote (home-based outside Switzerland) Start date: January 2027 Application deadline: 10/12/2026 Background The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty-bearers and the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support for designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work. Role Summary The Systems & Digital Solutions Intern provides part-time operational support across GSF’s systems, business intelligence, data quality, information management and IT support services. The intern contributes to first-line user assistance, routine administration, testing, documentation, data cleansing and validation, and the organisation of information within GSF Online, SharePoint and other approved systems. Assignments are prioritised through a six-month work plan and include a structured handover to support continuity between successive internship placements. Position Responsibilities Systems and User Support Provide first-line support for GSF Online and other assigned systems, record support requests and contribute to an initial response within one business day; Support routine user-account and access administration under supervision, including approved access requests and periodic access reviews; Assist with system configuration, testing, issue reproduction and validation of fixes or new releases; Escalate unresolved, recurring, security-related or access-control issues promptly. Data Quality and Information Management Support data cleansing, migration, validation and follow-up of identified data-quality issues; Assist with routine data preparation and testing of Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs under technical guidance; Support consistent organisation of information in SharePoint, GSF Online and other approved systems, including naming, storage and permissions; Maintain clear records of completed checks, identified issues and follow-up actions. Documentation, Training and Continuity Prepare and update user guides, FAQs, process documentation and training materials; Support system demonstrations, training sessions and user-adoption activities; Complete priority assignments agreed through the six-month work plan and provide regular progress updates; Prepare a structured handover of open tasks, documentation and learning for the next internship placement. Position Requirements Education and Experience The position is open to students currently enrolled in a master’s program in information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a related field. Please note a tripartite agreement is mandatory for this internship; Interest or initial experience in business systems, data quality, reporting, user support or information management; Familiarity with Microsoft 365; experience with Power BI, SharePoint or similar platforms is an asset. Other Requirements Good written and spoken English; French or another GSF working language is an asset. Analytical, organised and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail and confidentiality; Ability to learn quickly, document work clearly and escalate issues appropriately; Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and predominantly remote environment; Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and responsible use of data and technology. How to apply Please click apply to submit your application by 10th December 2026 (midnight CET). Kindly note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. ____________________________________________________________________________________ The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) is dedicated to fostering diversity, gender balance, and inclusion, reflecting the varied landscapes where we operate and the communities we work with. We welcome applications from qualified professionals of all backgrounds, cultures, and beliefs. We particularly encourage candidates from regions where GSF is active to apply. At GSF, we are committed to enforcing stringent Safeguarding policies, covering protection from exploitation, abuse, harassment, misuse of power, and discrimination, as well as child safeguarding and financial and fiscal integrity. We uphold a zero-tolerance approach to any form of unacceptable behaviour. As part of our recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be required to provide references from previous employers and complete a self-declaration. GSF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, or hiring processes (i.e. application stage, interview stage, validation stage, appointment, or training). GSF will never request applicants’ bank account information. Please note that candidates must be authorised to work in the country where the position is based at the time of application. Your Data - If you choose to apply for this position, you will be providing us with your personal data, which will be processed solely for the purpose of selecting a candidate for this position. We will retain the personal data you share with us as part of the application process for six months from the application deadline, after which it will be deleted.
